# TypePotijogita

> TypePotijogita is a free online typing speed test and typing competition platform. Users measure WPM and accuracy, practise with real-time feedback, and compete in live global typing contests and leaderboards.

## Core features
- Typing speed test (15, 30, 60 and 120 second runs) with live WPM, accuracy and error counting
- Practice mode with paragraph passages, quotes and your own pasted text (English, Bangla and Hindi)
- 1v1 typing battles and scheduled typing contests with Elo ratings
- Global leaderboards, one board per run length
- Personal progress: a 7/30/90-day curve, streaks, personal bests and badges

## Scoring
One word counts as five characters, spaces included. WPM = (correct characters ÷ 5) ÷ minutes elapsed. Accuracy is the share of typed characters that matched the passage. Runs of different lengths are ranked in separate leaderboards and are never compared with each other.

## Notes
- The typing test works without an account; an account is only needed to save results, appear on leaderboards, join contests and unlock badges.
- Member areas (practice, battles, contests, leaderboard, progress, achievements) require a signed-in session.
- Source code: https://github.com/SakibFakir69/TypeRush-client
